sermon.title: Was There A Beginning Before Genesis?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: A short clip gathering scriptures that point to a beginning before Genesis 1: Christ the beginning, the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world, and believers chosen in Him before it.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.section_question: Was there a beginning before Genesis 1?
chunks.short_answer: Yes—Jesus is the beginning and the end, the beginning of the creation of God.
chunks.text: We have found scriptural evidence that there was a beginning before Genesis 1 beginning when God created the heavens and the earth we found in the scriptures that Jesus said I am the beginning and I am the end I am the first and I am the last all these are found in Revelations. These things says the amen the faithful and true witness the beginning of the creation of God Jesus was the beginning his birth foretold his death foretold for the sins of the world at the very beginning of creation in Colossians chapter 1 he says Christ is the head of the body the church who is the beginning.

scriptures.text_nkjv: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End, the First and the Last.”
“And to the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write, ‘These things says the Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of the creation of God:
And He is the head of the body, the church, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things He may have the preeminence.

chunks.section_question: What was decided before the foundation of the world?
chunks.short_answer: The Lamb slain; Christ predetermined to die for our sins, revealed in these last times.
chunks.text: Again in Revelations the lamb was slain from the foundation of the world also in Matthew 13 I shall declare things hidden before the foundation of the world. And again in first Peter 1:18. You were redeemed with the precious blood of Christ a lamb without blemish without spot. Who truly was predetermined before the foundation of the world before the foundation before the creation of the world he was predetermined to come and die for our sins he was made plain, made manifest in these last times to us.

chunks.short_answer: God chose us in Christ before the foundation of the world, and the Father loved Jesus then.

And in John 17:24 Jesus was praying to the father and said father you loved me before the foundation of the world so there was a beginning before the Genesis 1 beginning and we have solid scriptural evidence of that.

faqs.question: What did Jesus call Himself?
faqs.answer: The beginning and the end, the first and the last.

faqs.question: What does Colossians 1 call Christ?
faqs.answer: The head of the body, the church, who is the beginning.

faqs.question: Was His birth and death foretold at the beginning?
faqs.answer: Yes, at the very beginning of creation.

faqs.question: When was the Lamb slain?
faqs.answer: From the foundation of the world.

faqs.question: What did Matthew 13 declare?
faqs.answer: Things hidden from the foundation of the world.

faqs.question: When did God choose us?
faqs.answer: Before the foundation of the world.

faqs.question: When did the Father love Jesus?
faqs.answer: Before the foundation of the world.
